columns.name: caja_abierta_id
columns.definition: CHAR(36) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN cerrada_en IS NULL THEN caja_id ELSE NULL END) VIRTUAL

checks.name: ck_sesion_caja_04
checks.expression: cerrada_en IS NULL OR cerrada_en >= abierta_en

checks.name: ck_sesion_caja_05
checks.expression: (cerrada_en IS NULL AND total_esperado IS NULL AND total_contado IS NULL) OR (cerrada_en IS NOT NULL AND total_esperado IS NOT NULL AND total_contado IS NOT NULL)

columns.name: plato_activo_id
columns.definition: CHAR(36) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN activa=1 THEN producto_plato_id ELSE NULL END) VIRTUAL

checks.name: ck_venta_02
checks.expression: (estado = 'PAGADA' AND numero_factura IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(numero_factura) <> '' AND pagada_en IS NOT NULL) OR (estado <> 'PAGADA' AND pagada_en IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_venta_03
checks.expression: pagada_en IS NULL OR pagada_en >= creada_en

columns.name: venta_confirmada_id
columns.definition: CHAR(36) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN estado='CONFIRMADO' THEN venta_id ELSE NULL END) VIRTUAL

checks.name: ck_pago_03
checks.expression: (estado = 'CONFIRMADO' AND confirmado_en IS NOT NULL) OR (estado = 'RECHAZADO' AND confirmado_en IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_movimiento_inventario_05
checks.expression: (tipo_origen='VENTA_DIRECTA' AND venta_id IS NOT NULL AND receta_id IS NULL AND componente_no=0 AND cantidad_delta<0) OR (tipo_origen='RECETA' AND venta_id IS NOT NULL AND receta_id IS NOT NULL AND componente_no>0 AND cantidad_delta<0) OR (tipo_origen='ENTRADA' AND venta_id IS NULL AND receta_id IS NULL AND componente_no=0 AND cantidad_delta>0) OR (tipo_origen='AJUSTE' AND venta_id IS NULL AND receta_id IS NULL AND componente_no=0)

checks.name: ck_asiento_contable_02
checks.expression: (tipo_origen='VENTA' AND venta_id IS NOT NULL AND liquidacion_id IS NULL) OR (tipo_origen='NOMINA' AND venta_id IS NULL AND liquidacion_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_evento_integracion_02
checks.expression: (tipo='VENTA_CONFIRMADA' AND venta_id IS NOT NULL AND liquidacion_id IS NULL) OR (tipo='NOMINA_APROBADA' AND venta_id IS NULL AND liquidacion_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_evento_integracion_03
checks.expression: (estado='PROCESADO' AND procesada_en IS NOT NULL AND ultimo_error IS NULL) OR (estado='PENDIENTE' AND procesada_en IS NULL AND ultimo_error IS NULL) OR (estado='ERROR' AND procesada_en IS NULL AND ultimo_error IS NOT NULL)
